title: FactForge Captions
description: Validates remotion/captions.json - short, sequential on-screen subtitle bursts synced to the narration. Generated mechanically by scripts/generate_captions.mjs from scripts/script.md's section timestamps and remotion/composition.json's fps/duration_frames; merged into scene_config.json's top-level captions field by remotion_build.mjs. Never hand-edited.
